facts.text: A strength-t covering array guarantees that every combination of values of any t factors appears in at least one test.

facts.text: Covering arrays are efficient for large discrete configuration spaces, such as site type by weather by light by object type by machine model.

facts.text: NIST's combinatorial testing program found that most software bugs and failures are caused by one or two parameters, with progressively fewer caused by three or more parameters, up to about six.
